blocks.text: Chagres National Park and the Emberá Village

provenance.rationale: The approved Word titles Day 3 as a visit to the Emberá village in Chagres; the heading is rendered as a concise destination label.

blocks.text: After breakfast, travel to Chagres National Park and the Emberá village of Tusipono, reached by traditional dugout canoe along rainforest-lined riverbanks. Learn about the origins, customs and everyday life of the Emberá people, their handicrafts including cocobolo woodwork and woven baskets, and enjoy traditional dances. Continue by river to Chorro del Mono waterfall, where you can swim. A traditional lunch features fried tilapia, fried plantains and fruit.

blocks.text: In the morning, transfer to Albrook domestic airport and take the included flight to David, the capital of Chiriquí province. On arrival, continue by road to Boca Chica and check in at Cala Mia Island Resort on a private Pacific island. The setting offers privacy, small islands, mangrove bays, beaches and wooden villas, away from urban infrastructure. The remainder of the day is free.
